shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && git ls-files | head -50 && find .agents -type f | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx AGENTS.md; ls __agent_eval__; grep -n -i -B2 -A25 "i18n" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -30; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh i18n; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure Select SegmentedRadioGroup RadioButton Text; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md | head -150; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build 2>/dev/null

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure Lang Select SegmentedRadioGroup RadioButton Text; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -60; cat tsconfig.json; grep -rn "lang\|Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -i "configure\|useUIKitContext" README.md | head; find . -name "configure*.d.ts" -not -path "./node_modules/*" | head; find . -path "*SegmentedRadioGroup*" -name "*.d.ts" | head -3; find . -path "*Select/types.d.ts" | head -2

sed -n 80,115p README.md; cat build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n -A25 "interface ControlGroupProps" components/types.d.ts; cat utils/configure.js; cat components/utils/addComponentKeysets.js 2>/dev/null | head -30; grep -rn "subscribeConfigure" --include=*.js . | head
cat components/theme/useLang.js; grep -n "lang" components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts components/theme/ThemeProvider.js; cat i18n/i18n.js

cat > /tmp/i18n-check.test.ts <<'EOF'
EOF
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8; git status --short
